nodes.label: .`401 is always a session problem regardless of message`()
.`RLS rejection is never treated as a token problem`()
.`non RLS data errors are never treated as a token problem`()
.`legacy message fallback still catches jwt text when no status is available`()
.`network or unrelated errors are not session problems`()
.`session resolves to logged out and still counts as resolved`()
.`session that settles shortly after start resolves`()
.`timeout is not conflated with a settled logged out state`()
.`access token well within grace period needs no manual refresh`()
.`access token at or under the grace threshold must defer`()
.`failed refresh with a still usable authenticated session can proceed`()
.`failed refresh with an expiring authenticated session is deferred`()
.`failed refresh while SDK still restoring or in RefreshFailure defers`()
.`failed refresh with logged out status means genuinely logged out`()
